definitions.explanation: A plastic tape coated with a magnetizable layer, used to record audio, video, or computer data. Though largely replaced by digital storage, it is still used for long-term data archiving.

examples.english: Magnetic tape is still used today for the long-term storage of large amounts of data.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{磁気|じき}→磁気：03334_jiki⟧ (magnetism) and the loanword ⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧ (tape). Covers cassette audio tapes, VHS video tapes, and computer backup tapes. Although consumer use has declined dramatically, magnetic tape remains important for enterprise data archiving because of its low cost per terabyte and long shelf life.
